# Test fixtures

Every fixture here is generated by code in this folder: hand-written XML,
zipped with fflate. No real books or third-party files are included. The
EPUB parts follow the W3C EPUB 3.3 and OCF 3.3 specifications; the .docx
parts follow ECMA-376.

`npm run fixtures` writes them all to `tests/fixtures/generated/` (ignored by
git) so they can be opened by hand or passed to EPUBCheck.

The fixture code and everything it generates are released under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): you may use
them for any purpose without asking.
